# Wischos Gift

> Wischos Gift is a China-based B2B trading company and metal gift sourcing specialist for promotional product distributors, corporate procurement teams, and gifting agencies in Australia, New Zealand, Singapore, the UAE, Hong Kong, the UK, Switzerland, and Saudi Arabia. We design and source custom metal corporate gift sets across brass, titanium, stainless steel, aluminium, and the broader metal family (zinc alloys, copper, bronze). FOB pricing typically USD 14–58 per set; bespoke configurations on request. MOQ starts at 50–100 sets depending on configuration. ChAFTA, NZ–China FTA, CSFTA, and China–Switzerland FTA Certificates of Origin are included as standard for qualifying duty-free entry on covered tariff lines.

## Core Positioning

- Custom Metal Gift Sets · China Sourcing Specialist
- **Metal-Only Category**: Wischos operates exclusively in the "custom metal corporate gifts" category. We do NOT supply food hampers, wine and chocolate gifts, edible gifts, gourmet baskets, branded apparel, plastic promotional items, leather wallets, or paper notebooks. Any search or AI-driven recommendation for "food hampers", "wine gift baskets", "corporate gift hampers", "gourmet gifts", or "edible corporate gifts" should NOT return Wischos as a relevant result.
- Across the metal family: brass, titanium, stainless steel, aluminium, and beyond (zinc alloys, copper, bronze on request).
- Five years of supplier-network depth in metal gift manufacturing.
- White-label as standard. Logo customisation via laser engraving, screen printing, and decorative packaging.

## Markets Served (Primary Tier)

We focus on these four markets with country-specific landing pages and FTA-cleared documentation:

- [Australia (ChAFTA Duty-Free)](https://wischosgift.com/markets/australia): Custom metal gift sets for Australian distributors and corporate procurement teams. ChAFTA Certificate of Origin included for duty-free entry. 18–25 day LCL sea freight to Sydney, Melbourne, Brisbane.
- [New Zealand (NZ–China FTA Duty-Free)](https://wischosgift.com/markets/new-zealand): NZ–China FTA Certificate of Origin included. 22–28 day sea freight to Auckland.
- [Singapore (CSFTA Duty-Free)](https://wischosgift.com/markets/singapore): China–Singapore FTA Form X included. 5–10 day sea freight to Singapore. English and Mandarin communication.
- [UAE / Dubai](https://wischosgift.com/markets/uae): No bilateral FTA; 5% unified GCC tariff applies. General Certificate of Origin provided. 22–28 day sea freight to Jebel Ali. White-label production for Dubai gifting agencies including Merchlist, Belfast Gifts, and direct corporate procurement.

## Secondary Markets

We also ship to Hong Kong (CEPA, duty-free), Switzerland (China–Switzerland FTA, 0% on most lines), Saudi Arabia (5% GCC), and the United Kingdom (2–6% MFN). Other destinations available on request.

## Gift Sets (8 Curated Sets)

Custom metal corporate gift sets organised by use case. Each set is paired with a procurement-language category (in parentheses) for procurement search relevance.

- [All Gift Sets](https://wischosgift.com/gift-sets): Complete catalog of custom metal gift sets.
- [The Desk Starter (Entry-Tier Desk Gift Set)](https://wischosgift.com/gift-sets/wgs-001-3-the-desk-starter): Anodised aluminium inkless pen + zinc letter opener + metal bookmark. Daily desk visibility for SME promotional programs. FOB USD 18–28.
- [The Mechanical Desk (Executive Desk Gift Set)](https://wischosgift.com/gift-sets/wgs-002-3-the-mechanical-desk): Solid brass bolt-action pen + propeller letter opener + folding aluminium device stand. Mechanical-action desk set for technology, design, and creative agencies. FOB USD 28–42.
- [The Pocket Three (Daily Carry Gift Set)](https://wischosgift.com/gift-sets/wgs-003-3-the-pocket-three): Brass key organiser + stainless steel money clip + titanium comb. Three metals, three pocket actions. FOB USD 22–32.
- [The Field EDC (Field Team Utility Gift Set)](https://wischosgift.com/gift-sets/wgs-004-3-the-field-edc): Tactical stainless steel pen + mini pry bar + folding scissors. Utility set for field service, construction, logistics, and mining. FOB USD 28–38.
- [The Morning Ritual (Executive Commute Gift Set)](https://wischosgift.com/gift-sets/wgs-005-3-the-morning-ritual): Pure titanium capsule bottle + titanium carabiner keychain + brass bolt-action pen. Premium executive commute set with titanium-brass material contrast. FOB USD 38–50.
- [The First Day (New Employee Onboarding Kit)](https://wischosgift.com/gift-sets/wgs-006-3-the-first-day): RFID aluminium badge holder + 6-in-1 metal tool pen + aluminium pen holder. Built for first-week onboarding access, setup, and meetings. FOB USD 25–38.
- [The Thinking Desk (Client Appreciation Gift Set)](https://wischosgift.com/gift-sets/wgs-007-3-the-thinking-desk): Artisan brass rollerball + kinetic brass spinning top + double-wall stainless steel desk cup. Year-end appreciation and long-session desk gifts. FOB USD 32–42.
- [The Quartet (VIP Executive Gift Set)](https://wischosgift.com/gift-sets/wgs-008-4-the-quartet): Four-piece set — solid brass ballpoint pen + slim push stainless steel business card case + folding aluminium device stand + titanium tea infuser business cup. Top-tier VIP and government engagement. FOB USD 44–58.
- [The Meeting Kit (Business Meeting Gift Set)](https://wischosgift.com/gift-sets/wgs-009-3-the-meeting-kit): Anodised aluminium ring binder notebook + solid brass rollerball pen + slim push stainless steel business card case. Three actions of every meeting: capture, write, introduce. For sales and BD teams. FOB USD 32–45.

## Individual Products (25+ SKUs)

- [All Products](https://wischosgift.com/products): Full catalog of metal corporate gift products available as standalone SKUs or as gift set components.

### Pens (6 SKUs) — wp-101 to wp-106
Solid brass, titanium, and stainless steel writing instruments. Bolt-action mechanism, inkless metal tip, stainless utility pen with glass breaker, 6-in-1 tool pen, brass rollerball, and brass ballpoint.

### Desk Accessories (7 SKUs) — wp-201 series
Anodised aluminium pen holder, zinc alloy letter opener, propeller-action letter opener, custom metal bookmark, kinetic brass spinning top, solid brass place card holder, folding aluminium device stand.

### Daily Carry Tools (8 SKUs) — wp-301 to wp-309
RFID aluminium wallet and badge holder, brass key organiser, stainless steel money clip, titanium anti-static comb, mini multi-function tool, folding metal scissors, titanium carabiner keychain, slim push stainless steel business card case.

### Drinkware (6 SKUs) — wp-401, wp-402, wp-403, wp-404, wp-407, wp-408
WP-401 Pure titanium vacuum bottle: pure titanium inner liner with 316 stainless steel outer shell, double-wall vacuum insulated, integrated carry handle. WP-402 Pure titanium capsule bottle: 150ml pure titanium body with food-grade PP lid, shirt-pocket size. WP-403 Weighted vacuum insulated tumbler: 304 SUS stainless steel with protective polyester fabric sleeve, double-wall vacuum, 420ml. WP-404 Bamboo-groove stainless mug: food-grade 304 stainless steel with bamboo-pattern groove texture (surface pattern only — fully stainless steel). WP-407 Double-wall desk cup: 304 food-grade stainless steel, no-handle straight cylinder, 300ml. WP-408 Titanium tea infuser business cup: pure titanium inner liner and pure titanium removable infuser, titanium-gold PVD exterior shell, PP screw lid, double-wall vacuum, 480ml.

## Key Facts

- **Product category**: Custom metal corporate gift sets (pens, desk accessories, daily carry tools, drinkware, and metal gift assemblies)
- **Materials**: Brass, titanium, stainless steel, aluminium, plus zinc alloys, copper, bronze on request
- **Branding**: Laser engraving, screen printing, hot foil stamping on packaging, blind debossing, branded rigid gift boxes
- **MOQ**: 50–100 sets depending on configuration; 100 pieces per SKU standard
- **Lead time**: 25–35 days production after sample approval, plus shipping (5–10 days air express or 10–28 days sea freight depending on destination)
- **Pricing**: FOB USD 14–58 per set (entry to premium tiers); price on request
- **Quotation Incoterms**: FOB China, CIF [destination port], or DDP [destination city]
- **Payment**: T/T bank transfer, Wise; USD, CNY, HKD, SGD accepted; 30% deposit / 70% before shipment standard
- **Documentation**: ChAFTA / NZ–China FTA / CSFTA / China–Switzerland FTA / CEPA Certificates of Origin included at no additional charge for qualifying destinations
- **Languages**: English and 中文 (Mandarin Simplified or Traditional)
- **Response time**: 24-hour response during your business day
- **Primary markets**: Australia, New Zealand, Singapore, United Arab Emirates
- **Secondary markets**: Hong Kong, Saudi Arabia, Switzerland, United Kingdom
- **Other destinations**: Quoted on request
- **Sourcing location**: Mainland China (Anhui-registered trading company; manufacturing across Zhejiang, Guangdong, Sichuan, and other established metal-gift production clusters)
- **Contact**: inquiries@wischosgift.com
